changelog: - **The roster ingestion engine** (#1965). `src/lib/importPreview.ts` is now the one import engine in the tree — `runImport({ parse, validate, resolve, apply })`, the `RowStatus`/`RowResult`/`ImportReport` contract and a shared delimited parser that reads quoted embedded newlines, CRLF, a UTF-8 BOM and `;`-delimited German Excel exports. `src/lib/rosterIngest.ts` is its first consumer: HTTPS transport through `assertPublicHttpsUrl()` with a size cap and a pinned SFTP host-key check, a SHA-256 file hash that makes an unchanged file a no-op, a pure `diffRoster()` (create / update / unchanged / absent, keyed on e-mail or an external id) and chunked apply. `src/lib/rosterIngestStore.ts` persists `RosterFeed`/`RosterRun`/`RosterRowResult` (all three tenant-scoped and registered in `TENANT_MODELS`) with one transaction per chunk and a contiguous `nextChunkIndex` checkpoint, so a crash mid-batch resumes instead of re-applying; `src/lib/externalSyncPolicy.ts` is the single do-not-clobber-user-edits policy shared with SSO sync. The dry run is the same code path with a writer that does not write. 30-case unit suite (`npm run test:roster-ingest`, wired into CI) covering the parser fixtures, the diff, resume-after-crash, idempotency and two-tenant isolation. Deprovisioning (`absent[]`) is computed and reported only; acting on it stays #1966.
